source.source: Guțu et al. 2025, secondary citation to Chornolata et al. 2018
source.source_title: The Evaluation of the Biomass Quality of Lolium perenne 'Măgura' and Phleum pratense 'Tirom' Grown under the Conditions of Moldova
source.geography: Chişinău, Moldova; Phleum pratense 'Tirom' monoculture forage
source.source_location: p. 974, Results and Discussions; paragraph attributes 1.88% starch in Phleum pratense to Chornolata et al. (2018). The 2025 study's own Table 1 does not measure starch.
source.source_type: peer-reviewed secondary literature report; primary 2018 source not recovered
source.primary_reference: Chornolata, L.P.; Horbachuk, T.V.; Liakhovchenko, I.A. (2018). Carbohydrate fractions in the green mass of forage crops. Feeds and Feed Production, issue 85, pp. 132–137 (in Ukrainian). The 2025 source reference list identifies this citation; the primary article and its methods/data have not been verified.
source.primary_reference_status: Bibliographic citation identified from the 2025 paper; primary full text, measurement protocol and uncertainty not verified; no DOI located.
source.basis: Published value 1.88% of dry matter converted to 18.8 g/kg dry matter, then to 0.0026884 kg/kg wet grass using the measured VARTA dry-matter fraction 0.143. The value is attributed to Phleum pratense in the cited secondary paper; it is not a GreenHub roadside-grass measurement.
source.applicability: Low-transferability literature proxy: Timothy (Phleum pratense) forage in Moldova used for mixed roadside-grass feed. The primary Chornolata et al. (2018) source and sampling uncertainty have not been recovered.
source.uncertainty: No standard deviation or range is reported for the cited 1.88% value; between-species, harvest-stage and site variability are not quantified.
